items.source: Create a new CachingDestinationResolverProxy, setting the target DestinationResolver through the setTargetDestinationResolver(DestinationResolver) bean property.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 `CachingDestinationResolverProxy`，通过 `setTargetDestinationResolver(DestinationResolver)` bean 属性设置目标 `DestinationResolver`。

items.source: DestinationResolver implementation that proxies a target DestinationResolver, caching its resolveDestination(String) results. Such caching is particularly useful if the destination resolving process is expensive (for example, the destination has to be resolved through an external system) and the resolution results are stable anyway.
items.translation: 实现 `DestinationResolver` 接口以代理目标 `DestinationResolver`，并缓存其 `resolveDestination(String)` 的结果。如果目的地解析过程代价高昂（例如，需要通过外部系统解析目的地），且解析结果本身是稳定的，那么这种缓存尤其有用。

items.source:
Create a new CachingDestinationResolverProxy using the given target
DestinationResolver to actually resolve destinations.
items.translation: 使用给定的目标 DestinationResolver 创建一个新的 CachingDestinationResolverProxy，以实际解析目的地。

items.source:
Resolves and caches destinations if successfully resolved by the target
DestinationResolver implementation.
items.translation: 如果目标 DestinationResolver 实现成功解析，则解析并缓存目的地。

items.source: Set the target DestinationResolver to delegate to.
items.translation: 将目标 DestinationResolver 设置为委派给的对象。

items.source: resolveDestination in interface DestinationResolver<D>
items.translation: `resolveDestination` 在接口 `DestinationResolver<D> 中。

items.source: DestinationResolutionException - if the target DestinationResolver reports an error during destination resolution
items.translation: DestinationResolutionException - 如果目标 DestinationResolver 在解析目的地时报告错误

items.source: targetDestinationResolver - the target DestinationResolver to delegate to
name - the destination name to be resolved
the currently resolved destination or an already cached destination
items.translation: 当前解析的目的地或已缓存的目的地

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。
